scope: Post-clear handback under split actor/group locality
finding: Both command issue and deferred retention required actor locality. When new group intent arrived during a split, a living stopped actor lost its receipt before the owner could perform handback.
implementation: Retain original receipt metadata for living same-group on-foot non-player remote actors still observed STOP. No remote command or new position. Local re-observation retains all strict task, authority and recorded-position requirements. Existing public row filtering carries only retained original posts.
limits: Remote observations can be stale; retention grants no authority or movement.
Addon shutdown remains a terminal release path, not an indefinite handback observer.
